guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails during building at Step 5/17 with this error: "update-alternatives: <link> and <path> can't be the same". This happens because the command `update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3 1` attempts to set /usr/bin/python3 as an alternative for itself, which is invalid. Since Ubuntu 22.04 already has python3 at /usr/bin/python3 and default python points to python3, these update-alternatives commands are redundant and faulty. To fix this, remove the line that runs `update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3 1`. The first command setting python to python3 is sufficient; or simply ensure python3 is available and python points to python3 by confirming use of the correct default. This fix will allow the Dockerfile to build successfully.
